mapper.select: SELECT country_code, ai_prompt, continue_prompt, seed_version, user_modified, created_at, updated_at FROM recognition_prompt ORDER BY country_code
SELECT country_code FROM recognition_prompt ORDER BY country_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recognition_prompt (country_code, ai_prompt, continue_prompt, seed_version, user_modified) VALUES (#{countryCode}, #{aiPrompt}, #{continuePrompt}, #{seedVersion}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ai_prompt = IF(user_modified = 1 AND seed_version >= VALUES(seed_version), ai_prompt, VALUES(ai_prompt)), continue_prompt = IF(user_modified = 1 AND seed_version >= VALUES(seed_version), continue_prompt, VALUES(continue_prompt)), seed_version = IF(user_modified = 1 AND seed_version >= VALUES(seed_version), seed_version, VALUES(seed_version)), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO recognition_prompt (country_code, ai_prompt, continue_prompt, seed_version, user_modified) VALUES (#{countryCode}, #{aiPrompt}, #{continuePrompt}, #{seedVersion}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ai_prompt = VALUES(ai_prompt), continue_prompt = VALUES(continue_prompt), seed_version = VALUES(seed_version), user_modified = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO recognition_prompt (country_code, ai_prompt, continue_prompt, seed_version, user_modified) VALUES (#{countryCode}, #{aiPrompt}, #{continuePrompt}, #{seedVersion}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ai_prompt = VALUES(ai_prompt), continue_prompt = VALUES(continue_prompt), user_modified = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
